You will be shown a series of Java code snippets, for which you should determine the output. 
At the beginning of the study, you will be presented with six code snippets which you should read and memorize.
Afterwards you will be shown code snippets in one of three tasks.
You will have 30 seconds for each task.
In one type of tasks you will have to determine whether the code correctly implements the same functionality as one of the code snippets you memorized initially.
You should respond by pressing X if you believe the code does so and by pressing Y if you believe that it does not. 
In the second task type you will have to determine the output of a code snippet. 
Once you have determined the output of the code snippet respond by pressing X. 
If you are unable to determine the output respond by pressing Y.
In the third type of task you will be asked to find three syntax errors in a code snippet.
Once you have located all three errors you should respond by pressing X. 
If you are unable to locate all three errors you should respond by pressing Y.
If you run out of time on any task respond with Z.
